title: Palette JSON: color int type-checked but not range-checked before u8 truncation
detail: The cast validates the JSON value's TYPE (must be Integer) but not its RANGE. An out-of-range integer silently truncates via u8(n) instead of returning the default like a wrong-type value would — inconsistent validation at the palette JSON boundary.
recommended_fix: After the type assertion, range-check before the cast: if n < 0 || n > 255 { return def }. Keeps the fallback consistent for both wrong-type and out-of-range palette values.
